## 🚀 Featured Projects

<div align="center">

### 🪂 DroperOG

**Multi-source airdrop hunter & trust scanner.** Pulls signals from CoinGecko,
CryptoRank, CoinRanking, RSS and X, then scores every project for trust risk so you
don't chase honeypots.

### 🐦 twitter-telegram-bot

**Auto-forwards tweets from X to Telegram channels.** Give it a list of usernames,
